assumptions: No provider calls in this phase.
Normal production operation continues to create cutoff-safe predictions and settlements.
No retrospective prediction rows are fabricated.
Forecast rows become accepted only after authoritative settlement and feature linkage.

trainingEta.bestCase: about 1 month of normal production settlement or Stage B recovery success
trainingEta.expected: about 2 to 3 months, or immediately after all 596 recoverable rows are certified plus 50 new accepted rows
trainingEta.worstCase: about 4 to 6 months if settlement/recovery throughput is slow

roadmapSampleEstimates.name: Recover missing canonical evidence
roadmapSampleEstimates.action: repair canonical result and provider mapping gaps using stored metadata only before considering any imports
roadmapSampleEstimates.note: Stage A alone does not certify rows missing feature snapshots or model versions.

roadmapSampleEstimates.name: Recover feature completeness
roadmapSampleEstimates.action: link existing feature snapshots and model-version metadata where point-in-time evidence already exists
roadmapSampleEstimates.note: If all 596 recoverable rows can be proven cutoff-safe with features/model versions, the platform reaches 950 accepted rows.

roadmapSampleEstimates.name: Recover historical predictions
roadmapSampleEstimates.action: design-only gate for future approved historical prediction reconstruction; no replay is authorized by this phase
roadmapSampleEstimates.note: The 1,636 preview/shadow rows are partially recoverable only after legitimate settlement, production eligibility and contract review.

roadmapSampleEstimates.name: Historical imports
roadmapSampleEstimates.action: future approval gate for historical provider/archive acquisition, feature rebuild and replay
roadmapSampleEstimates.note: No provider calls, imports or feature rebuilds are authorized here.

roadmapSampleEstimates.name: Candidate training
roadmapSampleEstimates.action: eligible only after accepted rows exceed 1,000 and all governance gates pass
roadmapSampleEstimates.note: Training remains blocked until explicit future approval.
